transcript: I prioritize systems that balance environmental sustainability, fair governance, and human agency. I rank sustainable and institutional models highest because they provide the essential stability needed for human flourishing while placing data-driven and extreme low-tech models last due to the risk of either sacrificing human freedom or losing the benefits of collective human in progress.
